name: cursor-platform
description: Agent platform for .NET + React in regulated/fintech contexts. 97 skills, 14 read-only subagents, 7 enforcement hooks and 12 validators covering the whole loop: understand existing code, plan and size the work, generate it against local convention, prove it is done, and ship it safely.
//skills: Directory is auto-discovered at .claude/skills/. Listed explicitly so the manifest documents what ships.
//hooks: Not declared here. This repo wires its hooks in .claude/settings.json; the distributable plugin gets its own generated ./hooks/hooks.json from build-plugin.mjs, which sets this key itself.
